about: Needs a look (lib/needsLook.ts, lib/metadataQueue.ts and lib/permissions.ts run as they are; app/NeedsALook.tsx's facets held, shown and pressed, its rows, its ending, its reads and its words, components/MetadataEditor.tsx's queue buttons, app/You.tsx's Manage row, app/useQueueSummary.ts's count and app/App.tsx's who, read out of their source).

words.checkFailed: Couldn't check the library just now.
words.line: Albums whose tags, folder or cover need fixing, albums Navidrome doesn't list, and new downloads nobody has looked at yet. Open one to fix it, or to mark it fine as it is.
words.lineNoEdit: Albums whose tags, folder or cover need fixing, albums Navidrome doesn't list, and new downloads nobody has looked at yet. Open one to see what it has, or to delete it.
words.needsEdit: Fixing it needs Edit albums, which an admin hasn't given you.
words.ignoresUnsaved: deadwax can't save to its database (check DB_PATH), so an album you mark “It's fine as it is” will come back.
words.navidromeUnset: Navidrome isn't set up, so no album is checked against what it lists. It's set up in Server settings (Connections).
words.navidromeScanning: Navidrome was scanning when last asked, so only albums found missing before are marked “Not in Navidrome”.
words.navidromeWaiting: Navidrome hasn't answered yet, so no album is checked against it until the library is read again.
words.noPermission: This page needs a permission an admin hasn't given you - ask one if you need it.
words.skipHint: Leave this one for now and move on
